title: Peru: Blueberry exports reach record high, exceeding US$2.457 billion in 2025 | News | ANDINA - Peru News Agency - Agencia Andina
summary: Peru remained the world's leading producer and exporter of fresh blueberries at the close of 2025, with overseas shipments totaling US$2.457 billion—an 8.2% increase from 2024—according to the Ministry of Agrarian Development and Irrigation (Midagri).
